subject: general
question: The famous folk music of Rajasthan that was developed in royal courts is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maand folk music related to Rajasthan__ state.
 
• The classic Maand composition made immortal by legendary singers such as Allah Jilai Bai.
 
• The Best of Rajwadi Mand, offers valuable insights into Maand, the form of Rajasthani music that once flourished in the courts or Rajwadas of Rajasthan.
 
• The other artists featured in the compilation include Munshi Khan of Nagaur, Allah Jilai Bai of Bikaner, Lalita Bai of Kishangarh, the Jamila-Kulsum group from Jodhpur, Suraiyaa Begum from Jaipur, the Rukma-Hakla group from Barmer, and the Hasan Khan Manganiyar group from Jaisalmer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Know about Rajasthan:

 
• Capital: Jaipur
 
• Languages: Hindi, Rajasthani, Marwari, Mewari, Jaipuri.
 
• Major Rivers:
 
 
• Chambal owing from the Janapav to Madhya Pradesh
 
• Sabarmati owing from Aravalli Ranges to Gulf of Cambay
 
• Banas River – originates from Rajasthan and joins Chambal.
 
• Luni River owing from Aravalli Ranges.
 
 
 
• Geographical Indications: Kota Doria, Kathputlis, Blue pottery, Molela clay work, Sanganeri, Hand Block Printing, Phulkari, Bikaneri Bhujia, Bagru hand block print, Thewa artwork, Makrana marble.
 
• World Heritage Sites:
 
 
• Jantar Mantar
 
• Keoladeo National Park
 
• Chittorgarh Fort
 
• Kumbhalgarh
 
• Ranthambore Fort
 
• Gagron Fort
 
• Amber Fort
 
• Jaisalmer Fort
